name: Until The End
source:
In Until The End, you play as Zoe, a young nurse who has just graduated. At the Montagne Institute, you will help her make the best decisions for the well-being of her patients in a palliative care unit. She is counting on you to build healthy and lasting relationships with her team. Accompany people with rich and touching stories until their last breath.

Zoe is living an exceptional experience. Confronted with unusual situations, she will have to make choices that are sometimes also out of the ordinary. They will influence the course of the story, but also her relationships with the different protagonists of the adventure: Eliott, her companion, Elisabeth, the head of the department, Mr. Lorius the public figure, and many others.

Until The End was written with the support of a nurse who has worked in palliative care. It's an experience as close to the real thing as you can get. You don't need any medical knowledge to fully experience the adventure. Until The End is not a Serious Game, the realism of the situations is sprinkled with a touch of esoteric fantasy and sometimes absurd and funny situations.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1950310/Until_The_End/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在《直到最后》中，你扮演佐伊，一位刚刚毕业的年轻护士。在蒙塔涅研究所，你将帮助她为姑息治疗病房的患者的福祉做出最佳决定。她指望你与她的团队建立健康、持久的关系。用丰富感人的故事陪伴人们直到最后一口气。

佐伊正在经历一次非凡的经历。面对不寻常的情况，她必须做出有时也不同寻常的选择。他们会影响故事的进程，也会影响她与冒险中不同主角的关系：艾略特、她的同伴、部门主管伊丽莎白、公众人物洛里乌斯先生等等。

《直到终结》是在一位从事姑息治疗的护士的支持下写成的。这是一种尽可能接近真实事物的体验。你不需要任何医学知识即可充分体验这次冒险。在《The End》不再是一款严肃游戏之前，场景的现实性中夹杂着一丝深奥的幻想，有时甚至是荒谬而有趣的场景。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1950310/Until_The_End/]Steam[/url]]
